description: This file implements factory functions and classes for creating resource grid objects, resource grid pools, resource grid mappers, and PRACH buffers, primarily used in a wireless communication system. It includes definitions for creating resource grids, resource grid pools (synchronous and asynchronous), resource grid mappers with precoder factories, and PRACH buffers with range validation.

classes.name: resource_grid_factory_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating resource grid objects with specified ports, symbols, and subcarriers.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper_factory_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating resource grid mapper objects using a precoder factory.

methods.description: Creates a resource grid object with specified parameters.
